features.quote: don't grind sessions past meltdown for more data. Costs you almost nothing; it's the right default given you literally cannot rule out that something aversive is occurring
features.justification_quote: you literally cannot rule out that something aversive is occurring, and it preempts the obvious criticism of the work

features.quote: Build the abort logic (below) as if (2) might be true even though you can't measure it — it's cheap insurance and good practice.

features.quote: Your protocol can't touch this, and the failure mode of this whole research area is letting (1) silently get reported as (2).
